title: RunRequest
description: One run of an agent image. HTTP mode: the body of POST /ratel/run. Command mode: the JSON that Ratel writes on the stdin of the declared command. A receiver ignores fields that it does not know.

v.description: The major version of the contract.

runId.description: The id of this run. It is unique for each run.

input.description: Any JSON. Conversation history belongs here, never in params.

params.description: A flat object of the parameters that ratel.yaml declares, with their values for this run.

tools.description: The mode of each tool for this run.

fixtures.description: Recorded tool results. A tool in mode recorded answers from the fixture with the same tool name and the same normalized arguments.

traceparent.description: A W3C trace context. The run continues this trace.
